text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Here I come, Satsuki Sho! I'm not gonna
waste
this chance to win you!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Oh my gosh, they're seriously
broadcasting this
live. I feel sick... What
if I embarrass myself? Or
let everyone
down? Ugh, I wanna go home...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho, the first race of the
Classic
Triple Crown, is here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The atmosphere is electric with the
racers'
emotions. Their joy and anxiety at
qualifying for
the Satsuki Sho, their
fear—it all churns thickly in
the air.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone's so damn annoying.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur appears to be having a
difficult time
shutting out the energy
and emotions of those
around her.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's no different from any other race. You
run,
someone wins. That's it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Why waste energy gettin' all antsy
before the
race?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I'm also what? Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I nearly point out that she's talking a lot
more
than usual, but I decide against it
so as not to
upset her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Tch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that she's in her racewear, Shakur
looks
calmer than she did this morning,
but... she still
looks agitated.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but just barely. What're you askin'
me that
for now?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Sigh.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: See you in a bit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now all that's left is to hope she can
replicate the
results of her countless
simulations on the track.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's Air Shakur! I wonder how she's—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Glare!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Gulp. Sh-she's in fighting form, as always...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh... the noise is grating on me more
than
usual. Is the Satsuki Sho always this
bad?)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(No, I know what's behind this. Dammit,
my heart
rate's so high...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Deep breaths. The numbers'll prove it
soon
enough.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
They'll prove without a doubt that I'm
the
strongest one here today.
